text: System 10 created: clean package, data audited, 2026 sealed
Oracle region located: 79% of the best trades in 14% of the tape - but no edge by itself
Simple conditions tested: market breadth >= 50% positive in both unseen years
GPU training started: PPO deciding every 15 minutes inside the region
Actions changed to keep/switch after the policy learned never to trade
PPO refused: from churn to silence, no profitable checkpoint
Trade selector refused: wins 2024 on every seed, loses 2025 on every seed
Condition search started 24/7 (version A): regime averages 111/123/200/350, two models per regime
Search steered toward the availability rule (>= 70% of days tradeable)
Hourly success readings and this monitor added
